address: 132/8 Phet Kasem Road, Bang Nai Si, Takua Pa, Phang-Nga, 82110, Thailand
bio: The husband-and-wife team go to market every day to select fresh, local ingredients and seafood and offer a wide selection of Thai dishes. Check the blackboard for the specials which change every day, but the crispy softshell crab with a peppery chilli sauce is unmissable....
